pairs.difference: A is the real lighthouse from the lessons. A clear key from the left lights the left side of the tower, and the bricks turn into a cool core shadow on the right. B's house is lit from the front with low contrast. Both walls have about the same mid value, the glowing windows don't spill light onto the stone around them, and the moon behind it adds no rim light. Its light bias is 0.93, well above the real cards' 0.19–0.64.
pairs.fix: Light the house from the upper left so the left wall is clearly bright and the right wall falls into a cooler, darker shadow; let the window glow warm the stone around each frame; add a thin pale moonlit rim along the right roof edge.

pairs.difference: The seahorse has soft, gentle ridges lit from the upper left, with light shading inside the curl of the tail. The balloons have soft round turns and one sheen spot near the top of each. Both read like real-card modeling and all of their numbers are in range.

A's gloves have a strong left key, deep shadow in the folds of the thumb and cuff, and dark contact where they press against each other and the table. B's cauldron belly has an even, matte gradient. The flame under it barely lights the legs or the underside of the pot. The cast shadow to the right is a weak, soft smudge with no darker contact under the feet.
pairs.fix: Make the fire under the cauldron cast a warm orange glow on the underside and the inner faces of the legs; darken the floor right under each foot; give the iron belly one soft sheen on the upper left and a deeper shadow on the lower right.

pairs.difference: A's duck has a clear key from the upper left, a shadowed underside on the wing and belly, and a cast shadow on the sand. B's pumpkin is lit by an even front sheen. The glowing face doesn't light the rims of the cut-outs from inside, and the ribs turn into shadow without much depth. The body has a soft cast shadow but no real core shadow on the right side.
pairs.fix: Light the pumpkin from the upper left, with darker ribs on the right side; make the carved eyes and mouth glow and brighten their inner edges; add a firm, dark contact shadow where the pumpkin sits on the boards.

pairs.difference: A's fountain bowls have lit rims and dark undersides, and each tier casts shadow on the one below. B's black cat is modeled like smooth clay, with no fur breakup. The head and body have almost no core shadow, its light side and shadow side barely differ, and the cast shadow is a broad soft wash. Its shading range is 0.906, above the real range.
pairs.fix: Give the black cat a bright cool rim of light along its back, ears and head on the light side; let its far side sink into deep shadow; put a crisp, dark contact shadow under its paws and tail.

pairs.difference: A's sneakers have a strong key from the right, with a long dark cast shadow to the left and firm contact under the soles. B's tombstone face is lit flat from the front with nearly one value from top to bottom. Only the side edge darkens, and the cast shadow to the right is pale and diffuse.
pairs.fix: Rake the light across the tombstone from the upper left so the face goes from bright at the top left to darker at the lower right; make the cross and the crack cast small sharp shadows; darken the stone's shadow on the ground at its base.

pairs.difference: B's grad cap has a bright top board with a crisp front edge, and the board casts a darker shadow onto the skull cap under it. A's witch hat brim is evenly lit. The cone turns into shadow only slightly, the cone casts almost no shadow onto the brim, and form contrast is low at 0.361.
pairs.fix: Light the witch hat from the upper left, with a darker right side on the cone; have the cone cast a clear shadow across the brim behind it; add a soft sheen on the front of the brim and a dark underside.

pairs.difference: B's oil lamp glows from inside the chimney, and that warm light lands on the brass collar. A's candelabra is symmetric and lit from the front, with sharp hot spots on the base and arms. The three flames don't light the candle tops or cups. Its brass has no direction to the light.
pairs.fix: Let the three candle flames light the candle tops and the cups under them with warm light; put the main light on one side so one half of the candelabra arms falls into shadow; keep just one soft shine on the brass base.

pairs.difference: Both cards have a strong directional sun, and both light bias values are out of range. A's stone table and stools turn into shadow under their tops with dark contact on the grass. B's coffin front face is one flat lit plane. The open lid is a dark band, but the lid's slab casts almost no shadow onto the purple lining, and the moon behind it gives no rim light.
pairs.fix: Have the coffin lid cast a clear shadow onto the purple lining; shade the front face gradually from top to bottom; add a thin cool moonlit rim along the coffin's top edge; darken the grass right at its base.

pairs.difference: A's glass has soft refraction and a colored cast shadow on the purple table. B's crystal ball has a large, sharp white window highlight and a sparkle, which is a hard plastic hot spot. In the lens the ball turns into a murky, even value, and the gold stand's shine isn't tied to one light direction.
pairs.fix: Shrink the crystal ball's highlight to a small soft window on the upper left; darken the ball's lower right; let the glow inside the ball light the gold prongs; put a soft dark shadow under the stand on the shelf.

pairs.difference: B's scarf turns into soft shadow in its folds, with deep shading inside the loop and under the knot. A's broom has a strong one-sided gradient along the handle, which gives a light bias of 1.638, far above the real cards. Its bristles read as flat and pale, with little shadow between the strands or under the binding.
pairs.fix: Shade the broom bristles with darker gaps between the strands and a shadow just under the red binding; keep the handle a simple round tube with one soft sheen line instead of a light-to-dark wash along its length.

pairs.difference: A's flip-flops have a soft key from the upper left, raised straps that cast shadows onto the soles, and soft contact shadow. B's books are lit by soft window light with a glossy table reflection, and their spines have only a slight turn into shadow. The page blocks are evenly bright, and the shading range of 0.878 is above the real range.
pairs.fix: Light the books from the window on one side so the spines turn darker on the side away from it; put dark contact lines where each book sits on the one below; tone down the bright reflection on the table.

pattern: The generated cards are lit from the front, so the light side and the shadow side sit close in value. Glowing parts like pumpkin faces, windows, candle flames and the fire under the cauldron don't light the nearby surfaces. Cast shadows are pale, soft smudges with no dark contact under the object. Sharp white plastic hot spots appear where the real cards use one soft sheen. The real cards put the key on one side, so forms turn into a clear core shadow, and they add firm contact darkening at the base.
